blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Written from Jared's verified local notes (researched November 1, 2026). Listing-stated figures are labelled; unconfirmed items say so. No live feed filtered to 55+ homes yet.

In Sunnyside Park, Surrey, the 55+ homes you can buy are Semiahmoo Estates, 13965 16 Ave, Bishop's Green and St. Martin's Lane (strata). The other seniors housing here, which you cannot buy into, is retirement residence or care. This page names each building, says what type it is and what the sources show, and covers local rules and the questions buyers ask.
55+ strata buildings you can buy in Sunnyside Park
Semiahmoo Estates — 2239 152 St (Sunnyside Park)

MLS listings describe a "well-managed 55+ community" with a social lounge, exercise room, workshop and library, 1 underground parking stall and 1 storage locker, near shops, transit and Peace Arch Hospital. A rental-directory entry records 58 units / 3 storeys for the same address — that directory frames the building as rentals, which conflicts with the MLS strata-sale listings. Sources disagree: listings record built 1990 while a building directory records built 1991, and the same directory records the strata bylaws as age restrictions, pets not allowed and rentals not allowed — a residential rental-restriction bylaw has been void province-wide since Nov 24, 2022, so confirm the current position on the Form B.
13965 16 Ave (Sunnyside Park, at the White Rock border)

MLS listings for this building state "Wheelchair accessible, 55+" and describe an "adult-oriented condo in South Surrey White Rock" with a clubhouse, rooftop deck, library, workshop, exercise room, sauna and car wash, and 1 underground parking stall and locker. Source conflict on build year, flagged: listings for different units record 1988 and 1989.
Bishop's Green — 2533 152 St (Sunnyside Park as MLS places it)

MLS listings describe a "55+ gated community" / "highly sought after 55+ gated community of Bishop's Green," duplex-style rancher townhouses with walkout basements, a clubhouse, exercise centre and guest suite in listing amenity records, steps from the Semiahmoo Trail system. Build years in listings vary by unit (1991 and 1992 both appear) — treat the complex as phased/early-1990s in listing terms and confirm the unit's year on the strata plan. Postal-code spellings in listings also vary (V4P 1N4 in the MLS records checked).
St. Martin's Lane — 15020 27A Ave (Sunnyside Park as MLS places it, south edge)

MLS listings describe "Polygon's St. Martin's Lane in South Surrey" as a "55+ gated community" of half-duplex rancher townhouses with walkout basements, in-floor radiant heat and a clubhouse in listing amenity records, built 1995.
Rental, care and subsidized seniors housing in Sunnyside Park (not for sale)

items.t: Amica White Rock — 15333 16 Ave (Surrey, in the Sunnyside Park area): Despite the "White Rock" in its name, Amica's own address for the residence is 15333 16th Avenue, Surrey, South Surrey — physically on the Surrey side of 16 Avenue, one block from 152 Street, three blocks from Peace Arch Hospital in Amica's description. Rental retirement residence offering independent living, assisted living, memory care and licensed residential care, established 2019 in Amica's description; registered in BC's Assisted Living Registry as class SN (seniors), operator Prime Time (Abby Lane) Inc. It also houses the Abby Lane Health Centre medical clinic in the building. Care/rental — you cannot buy in.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Sunnyside Park

items.t: Do not confuse it with "Sunnyside Heights," a separate Grandview Heights neighbourhood plan area near 168 Street, 24 Avenue and Highway 99.

Where the verified 55+ stock sits: it runs down the 152 Street corridor and its side streets, not across the whole sub-area — Semiahmoo Estates at 2239 152 St and the building at 13965 16 Ave at the south end, Bishop's Green at 2533 152 St at the north end of the corridor's Sunnyside stretch, and St. Martin's Lane at 15020 27A Ave at the sub-area's south edge as MLS places it.
Nearby areas: Ocean Park to the south-west, Crescent Beach / Elgin Chantrell to the west, Semiahmoo Town Centre to the east, Morgan Creek / Rosemary Heights to the north-east.
SD36 schools: Surrey Schools catchments are address-based through the district's School Locator. T. Thrift Elementary and Semiahmoo Secondary, 1785 - 148 Street.

Parks and recreation: Bakerview Park, 1845 - 154 Street (Sunnyside Community Hall, garden, playground, baseball diamonds, soccer field); Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, 2598 144 Street (roughly 140 hectares, about 4 km of trails including the Wally Ross universal access trail); the Semiahmoo Trail runs through this part of South Surrey; South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre, 14601 - 20 Ave, and South Surrey Indoor Pool, 14655 17 Avenue.
Shopping: Semiahmoo Shopping Centre, 1711 152 Street, is the named centre beside this sub-area.
Transit: route 321 runs Surrey Central Station to White Rock Centre / White Rock South via King George Boulevard and 152 Street, stopping at White Rock Centre near this area.
Health care: Peace Arch Hospital, 15521 Russell Avenue, White Rock, is the nearest hospital — the 152 Street 55+ buildings are a short drive south of it, in the next municipality.

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Sunnyside Park

items.t: City zoning: Surrey Zoning Bylaw, 1993, No. 12000: provides the small-scale multi-unit housing zones RA to R6 for the detached streets around these complexes: up to 3 units on lots under 280 sq m, up to 4 units on lots over 280 sq m, and up to 6 units on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. This affects the house streets, not the strata lots inside the 55+ complexes.

Plans: the Semiahmoo Town Centre Plan borders this sub-area: The City's plan page records the plan was approved and later updated to align with the King George Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit and the Surrey 2050 OCP designations; the plan area, 16 Avenue to 24 Avenue from Martin Drive to Earl Marriott Secondary School, borders Sunnyside Park — land-use pressure on the 152 Street corridor's older low-rise stock comes from this plan, so a 55+ building's redevelopment context should be read there, not assumed.
Property taxes (city-wide, not area-specific): City of Surrey property taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty if not paid by midnight July 2 and a further 5% penalty after September 2.

For strata purchases: the Province's buyer paperwork path is Form B and Form F, strata bylaws and rules, fees and special levies, with filings confirmed at the Land Title Office — the Form B is where the age bylaw for any complex in is actually proved.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sunnyside Park

items.t: Sunnyside Park's 55+ stock and South Surrey's best-known 55+ complex are in different MLS sub-areas. Peninsula Village (2500 152 St, 95 townhomes) is filed under King George Corridor while Bishop's Green (2533 152 St) — a few blocks north on the same street — is filed under Sunnyside Park. A buyer searching only one sub-area's 55+ page misses half the 152 Street corridor.
The sub-area's boundary is an MLS filing, not a City line. Price comparisons "in Sunnyside" inherit that filing choice.

Highgrove (15055 20 Ave) is the sub-area's best-known townhouse complex, and its own listing states it has no age restrictions — a Sunnyside 55+ search that includes Highgrove is not accurate, however senior its buyer pool looks.

A building actually named "Sunnyside" is not a 55+ building. The Sunnyside building at 15290 18 Ave carries no age restriction in the directory record checked and is filed in King George Corridor; the name is a building name, not an age bylaw.

The care option inside the sub-area carries the neighbouring city's name. Amica White Rock is in Surrey (15333 16 Ave), opened as a Surrey residence in 2019 by its operator's account, and contains a medical clinic (Abby Lane Health Centre) in the building — the "stay in Sunnyside if care needs grow" option exists, but it is a rental residence, and its name will send a careless search to White Rock listings instead.
The Morgan Crossing / Grandview growth story is not this sub-area's 55+ story.

faq.q: What 55+ homes can I actually buy in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: Four complexes verified, all on or just off 152 Street: Semiahmoo Estates (2239 152 St, condo), the building at 13965 16 Ave (condo), Bishop's Green (2533 152 St, gated townhouses) and St. Martin's Lane (15020 27A Ave, gated townhouses). No 55+ rental building or subsidized complex was verified inside the sub-area.

faq.q: Do both of us have to be 55?
faq.a: Provincially, a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement (or holds a legacy exemption) is exempt, as are live-in caregivers and legacy residents. Peninsula Village listings (in the neighbouring sub-area) state the common local form expressly — "One person 55+" — but each Sunnyside complex's own bylaw wording must be confirmed in its Form B; no listing checked for the four in-sub-area complexes stated the one-occupant detail in terms.

faq.q: Are these single-level homes, or will I have stairs?
faq.a: Mixed by complex. The two condo buildings are apartment form (Semiahmoo Estates listings describe 1-bed units with in-suite laundry; the 13965 16 Ave listing describes a ground-level single-storey layout). Bishop's Green and St. Martin's Lane are rancher townhouses with walkout basements — main-floor living, but not stair-free homes; a buyer who needs true single-level living should verify the floor plan unit by unit.

faq.q: Is Amica White Rock in White Rock?
faq.a: No — despite the name, its address is 15333 16th Avenue, Surrey, on the Surrey side of 16 Avenue in this sub-area, three blocks from Peace Arch Hospital in the operator's description. It is a rental care residence, not a strata you can buy.

Building by building, and the sources conflict in tone: a building directory records Semiahmoo Estates as pets not allowed, while Peninsula Village listings next door (King George Corridor) state pets ok with a 2-pet limit in one listing. Read the individual complex's bylaws — do not carry one corridor building's pet rule into another.
Peace Arch Hospital, 15521 Russell Avenue, White Rock — in the next municipality, a short drive south on 152 Street from every complex in.
